selection.eligibility: all 30 completed eligible cases ranked; forecast-error metrics are tie-breaks, not vetoes; failed/incomplete cases excluded
selection.same_event_selection_limitation: All 30 candidates use the same event; this is diagnostic selection, not independent validation.
selection.initialization_limitation: QSNOW-only initial-water sensitivity is diagnostic and does not claim conservative or operational initialization.
selection.precipitation_limitation: Scores total surface precipitation, not surface snowfall alone.
